# Decision log, group B (WS-04, WS-05, WS-06, WS-13)

Fast-mode reconciliation, 2026-09-26 22:36–23:05 UTC. `reconciliation-decisions.md` never landed; inputs were `internal/build/reconciliation-queue.md` (all sections, including the E2E and Modal GPU benchmark sections of 22:03 / 22:28 UTC), `internal/build/layout-decisions-{geometry,ws-05,ws-13}.md`, and `internal/build/seam-decisions.md` (landed 22:36 UTC with `STATUS: complete`; its group-B rows SD-03…08, 10, 11, 17, 24…29, 34, 35, 40 were applied in the same pass). Only the four briefs in `docs/build/` were edited (template section order kept; 230 / 274 / 211 / 265 lines). No repo code, no PRs, no plan or contract doc touched. Source-of-truth order used: measured breadth report > handoff notes > contract docs > plan text; WS-00 authoritative for names unless a seam row amends it.

`GB-nn` = a decision made here (internal to the group or a reading of an ambiguous input). `SD-nn` = seam row applied as written.

## WS-04 pose backbone (`ws-04-pose-backbone.md`)

Applied: SD-01 (local attempt folders, upload on success), SD-03 (`poses/sparse/0/` replaces `poses/model/`; `fragments/<k>/sparse/0/`), SD-10 (`HSS_POSES_SFM_MAX_FRAMES=48`), SD-11 (`COLMAP_BIN` → `HSS_POSES_COLMAP_BIN`), SD-17/SD-24 (`server.poses.run(ctx)` wrapper owned by WS-04), SD-28/SD-29 (fixture paths; `mini-arkit` added), SD-34 (pycolmap 4.2.0 provisional, 3.11.1 proof path), SD-35 (A1/A6 port source, `colmap_prior.py` reference only), SD-40 (LaMAR gate 4.6 in); queue E2E row for WS-04; queue Modal benchmark rows 1–3; layout-decisions-geometry items 1, 2, 3, 9, 10, 20; layout-decisions-ws-13 I13 (LCPB fold risk) and D14 (recalibrated profile).

- GB-01 Frame budget (SD-10 + benchmark 96 / 186 / 237 s at 40 / 60 / 70). New `PoseParams.sfm_max_frames = 48`, `server/poses/thin.py`. Selection rule `[default chosen]`: meter frame(s) and close-ups first, then farthest-point on ARKit centres with a 20° heading rule (guided) or every k-th image (photo); leftovers via `image_registrator` (≤ 2.0 px, ≥ 30 points), then fixed-ARKit carry as `pose_source: arkit`. `registered_fraction` counts mapper + post-registered frames; `sfm_split` is judged on the mapper set. Report gains `frame_budget {sfm_max_frames, mapper_frames, registered_post, arkit_carried}`.
- GB-02 Runtime gate: `mapper_s ≤ 150 s` on L4 `[default chosen]` (between the measured 96 s at 40 and 186 s at 60 frames; the 48-frame value is interpolated, not measured); total ≤ 240 s and the 400 / 420 s timeouts unchanged (SD-10).
- GB-03 Port source flipped to A1/A6 (`a6-iphone-quality/a1_lamar.py` modes `prior_s03` / `fixed`, `a1-classical/sfm.py`) in a new `server/poses/sfm.py`; housepipe `colmap_prior.py` stays vendored as reference (SD-35). Verified on disk that housepipe now carries a 3.11.1 `_write_priors` and a raw-pointer C++ prior switch (`_prior_lib`, `/tmp/prior_setter.cpp`): both banned from the port. Start gate item 5 requires the "Why not housepipe" discrepancy note (24–26 in median / 39–47 in p90 / 0.19–0.83 m RMS vs 0.9–1.9 in) before any SfM code.
- GB-04 Toolchain: start gate item 1 and 4 now say `pycolmap==4.2.0` + matching COLMAP build (SD-34); §4 step 16 defines the parity test that can revert the pin (A6 `06-17 s0 prior_s03`: 99/99, −0.40 %, 0.088 m; tolerance identical / ±0.1 pp / ±0.01 m). `params` records `pycolmap` and `colmap` versions.
- GB-05 Real-phone gate is now a WS-04 acceptance item (§8.6, E2E consequence): five A6 segments through WS-11's runner, ≥ 60 % registered each, `06-17 s0` numbers, `max openings_p90_in ≤ 4.6` (SD-40), `far_p90_in` / `scale_error_pct` reported. The ETH3D `arkit-nonlidar` metric row is informational (E2E −2.95 % / +2.48 %). CI wiring stays WS-11's, fetchers WS-13's.
- GB-06 LCPB marked a fold-risk fixture (E2E §5 44/183 in 6 fragments vs manifest 151/183); the ≥ 60 % gate applies to the guided variant and `sfm_split` must fire rather than a merged fold.
- Ambiguity: SD-29 names the `mini-arkit` folder, not its manifest file name; commands use `packet*.json` via `ls`. WS-11's brief says its LaMAR runner seeds COLMAP with `seed=7 (WS-04's default)`; WS-04's default is `random_seed 0` (A6); WS-04 §3 now says WS-11 must pass WS-04's value (seam for group A / WS-11).

Applied: SD-01, SD-02, SD-03, SD-04 (no top-level `scene.scale`; mirror + copy), SD-05 (folder names; copies of every referenced asset), SD-06 (2D `objects.json` at `scene`, `objects_3d.json` at `merge_objects`, format ids), SD-08 (stage graph, `objects_3d` after `scene`), SD-11 (`HSS_GEOMETRY` → `HSS_DENSE_GEOMETRY`, `HOUSE_WEIGHTS` → `HSS_DENSE_WEIGHTS`, `HSS_SCENE_*` / `HSS_COVERAGE_*` knobs; `GROUND_RULE_DEFAULT` stays bare), SD-17/SD-24 (`run(ctx)` for `dense`, `coverage`, `scene`), SD-27 (angle band `[0, 30]` wall / `[20, 60]` ground), SD-28/SD-29, SD-34 (image note); queue E2E rows for WS-06, WS-10/14 (wall id + angle band) and WS-11 (harness bugs, mitigated on the writer side); queue structural objects-graph decision; layout-decisions-geometry items 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 14, 17, 21 confirmed.

- GB-11 Wall completion, new §4 step 11 (steps 12–22 renumbered; §9.7 reference updated to §4.22): ARKit `planes[]` (`vertical`, `classification: wall`, extent ≥ 1.0 m; unclassified vertical planes only when no `wall` plane exists) and taps `corner` / `wall_end_left` / `wall_end_right` extend fitted walls within 0.15 m / 5° or add `wp<k>` walls with `evidence: inferred`, `plus_minus_m 0.30`, chain join within 1.5 m, corners `inferred`; a `wall_end_*` tap sets `ends.<side>.point_m` but never `kind: limit` by itself. Coverage stays honest: completed walls get bands only from the grid. All thresholds `[default chosen]`. Fixture fact checked: the golden packets carry no `planes[]` (packetgen writes none) and only a `reference_point` tap, so completion is unit-tested on the synthetic box house and first exercised on WS-13's captures.
- GB-12 Coverage-driven `views_needed`, new §4 step 17: per chain wall, spans ≥ 0.5 m of absent / `unobserved` / `grazing` / `views < 2` / incidence > 75° stations → `band: wall` request with the head-on wording and `view_angle_deg [0, 30]`; ground strip 0–3.7 m → `band: ground`, `[20, 60]`; `unexplored` ends → `past_end`; cap 8, meter wall first `[default chosen]`. Written inside `coverage/coverage_report.json` (no new artifact beyond SD-05's list); WS-09 merges into verdicts, WS-10/14 render.
- GB-13 Phantom-wall guard (E2E §4 phantom wall left of w1): π³-dominated segments (≥ 90 %) with < 30 sparse points within 0.08 m are dropped with a warning; LiDAR/TSDF exempt `[default chosen]`.
- GB-14 Writer-side mitigations of the two E2E harness bugs: every `s_m` span sorted; `best_incidence_deg` / `worst_best_incidence_deg` clamped to [0, 90] with `incidence_clamped`. The harness fixes stay WS-11's.
- GB-15 Stub `scale.json` aligned to what WS-05 emits with no metric source: guided `rel_bound_95 0.09` (WS-05's ARKit-only modern posterior), photo `1.0` (WS-05 `no_scale_source`), was 0.06 / 0.5.
